# T-5: Add provider metrics

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Carry provider and profileKey identity from Agent.resolve through flow metric entries.

## Acceptance Criteria
- New agent metric entries contain provider and profileKey string fields.
- Built-in Claude/Codex providers produce their provider key.
- UserProvider entries use provider=user.
- Existing token/cache/cost/costIncomplete/model fields remain unchanged.
- Missing provider/profileKey values normalize to unknown at accumulateAgentMetrics.

## Implementation Notes
Provider identity may be derived from the Provider class key or registry resolution result. Avoid changing provider parse() usage values.

## Test Strategy
Agent/flow-store unit tests with fake usage and fake resolved profiles assert emitted metric entries.
